status: NOT PORTED, and it is a v2 at the earliest
why / where it would go: FlashAttention is not a faster spelling of the same arithmetic, it is an ONLINE softmax. The number of exp(old_max - new_max) rescalings is the number of KV TILES and the tile size is an execution-plan quantity, so two vendors with different tile widths perform different numbers of rounded rescalings on one row. The decode path splits K further and combines per-partition exp_sum with a partition count chosen from the shape and the machine. And the exponent base is exp2 with the 1/sqrt(d) scale folded into scale_log2e, so even the per-element arithmetic differs from exp(s - m). A bit-identical online softmax is a real object and it needs its own contract, its own oracle and its own separating fixtures. Contract section 6

It is a HALVING TREE. A halving tree is perfectly deterministic and perfectly launch-invariant and it computes a DIFFERENT SUM from the profile's serial ascending chain (contract 5.3). Reaching for the deterministic block fold BECAUSE it is the deterministic block fold is the single most likely way to get seam S17 wrong, and it would be wrong in a way that passes every launch-invariance gate. Sabotage S17_DENOM_HALVING_TREE is the arm
